gap.title: Graphs with no cycle shorter than 5, the open core: in a least top-form AND/OR circuit of fan-in two, the edges carried by junk AND gates number at most c (gates + 1)
gap.statement: ∃ (x1 : ℕ), ∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : SimpleGraph (Fin x2)) [x4 : DecidableRel x3.Adj], (∀ (x5 : Fin x2) (x6 : x3.Walk x5 x5), x6.IsCycle → (5 : ℕ) ≤ x6.length) → x3.edgeFinset.Nonempty → ∀ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO x3 x7 → PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm x3 x7 → (PEqualNP.TopForm.Ustar x3 x7).card ≤ x1 * (x7.size + (1 : ℕ))
gap.unlocks: Graphs with no short cycle, AND/OR circuits: the junk half of the bound, the open core
gap.context: SKETCH: no proof is held; open for REDUCTIONS. This is the open core in its narrow form: in a least top-form circuit, the edges carried by junk AND gates number at most c (gates + 1). Known on the record: the cases of no junk AND and of one are checked or on the desk (routes/lgp/full-basis/desk-formula-bound-final.md and desk-612-links.md); two or more is open. A cut should split by how junk ANDs nest and share. Size: unknown.
